title: gentiana tetramera
intro: Gentiana tetramera, commonly known as Himalayan gentian, is a rare and endangered plant species native to the Himalayas and the Tibetan Plateau. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Gentiana tetramera include reducing fever, alleviating pain, and treating various gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and iridoid glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
